content: Alesse®-28 tablets contain 0.10 mg of levonorgestrel and 0.02 mg of ethinyl estradiol. They are provided in packages that include three MINI-PACK™ dispensers, each containing 28 tablets. The product is identified by the National Drug Code (NDC) 0008-2576-02. Each dispenser includes: 21 active tablets, which are pink, round in shape, and marked with “W” on one side and “912” on the other. These tablets are identified by NDC 0008-0912. 7 inert (placebo) tablets, which are light green, round in shape, and marked with “W” on one side and “650” on the other. These tablets are identified by NDC 0008-0650. The tablets should be stored at a controlled room temperature of 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F), as recommended in the FDA Package Insert.
